newsitem.title: USA: Jefferies Group unit settles class action.
newsitem.headline: Jefferies Group unit settles class action.

text.p: Jefferies and Co Inc said on Thursday that it had settled a class action suit charging that the company engaged in improper trading practices on the Nasdaq market.
The company, a subsidiary of Jefferies Group Inc, denied any wrongdoing in the case and did not disclose terms of the settlement.
It said, however, that the settlement would have no impact on its third quarter earnings performances.
Jefferies and Co said it was one of 35 broker-dealers named in the litiagation, many of whom have already settled.
"We have fully reserved the amount required for the settlement, and it will not have any impact on our third quarter earnings," the company said in a statement.
